error-message.name: error-message
error-message.description: Displays an error message with an enter/leave animation. Used standalone or by form components.

button.name: button
button.description: A button with variants, sizes, a loading state, and leading/trailing icon slots.

text-input.name: text-input
text-input.description: A text input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Angular signal forms.

password.name: password
password.description: A password input with a show/hide toggle, built on the same form integrations as text-input.

select.name: select
select.description: A listbox select with search/filter, a clear button, viewport-aware panel placement, and custom templates for the trigger, options, icon, header, and footer.

switch.name: switch
switch.description: A toggle switch supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with sm/md/lg sizes and optional on/off icons.

checkbox.name: checkbox
checkbox.description: A checkbox supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with sm/md/lg sizes and an indeterminate state.

radio-group.name: radio-group
radio-group.description: A radio group supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with the same options/optionLabel/optionValue shape as Select.

textarea.name: textarea
textarea.description: A multi-line text input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with optional auto-resize and a character counter.

input-number.name: input-number
input-number.description: A numeric input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with min/max/step, increment/decrement buttons, and prefix/suffix text.

otp.name: otp
otp.description: A one-time-password input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with auto-advancing digit boxes and paste support.

multiselect.name: multiselect
multiselect.description: A multi-select listbox supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with search/filter, chips, select all/clear all, and viewport-aware panel placement.

popover.name: popover
popover.description: A popover controlled by reference from anywhere in the template (po.toggle($event)/show($event)/hide()), positioned against whatever triggered it.

tooltip.name: tooltip
tooltip.description: A [zTooltip] directive that shows a small floating label on hover/focus of any element.

divider.name: divider
divider.description: A horizontal or vertical rule, with an optional centered label.

skeleton.name: skeleton
skeleton.description: A shimmering loading placeholder block, with rect/circle/text shapes.

avatar.name: avatar
avatar.description: An image avatar with initials/icon fallback, sizes, circle/square shape, and a status dot.

tag.name: tag
tag.description: A small label/chip with color variants, an optional leading icon, and a removable state.

breadcrumb.name: breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: A trail of ancestor pages, using Angular's RouterLink for navigable items.

pagination.name: pagination
pagination.description: Page-number buttons with prev/next and optional first/last, collapsing to an ellipsis for large page counts.

rating.name: rating
rating.description: A star rating supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms -- clicking the currently-selected star clears it.

badge.name: badge
badge.description: A small notification indicator (count, "N+", or a dot) that overlays projected content, or renders inline in standalone mode.

accordion.name: accordion
accordion.description: A data-driven accordion with a required #content template slot per item, an optional custom #header slot, single- or multiple-open modes, and a pure-CSS expand/collapse animation.

tabs.name: tabs
tabs.description: A data-driven tab strip with a required #content template slot, an optional custom #label slot, horizontal/vertical orientation, a measured sliding indicator, and roving-tabindex keyboard navigation.

stepper.name: stepper
stepper.description: A step progress indicator with completed/active/upcoming states, linear (no-skip-ahead) mode, horizontal/vertical orientation, and an optional #content template slot for the active step's panel.

slider.name: slider
slider.description: A single-thumb range slider with drag/click-to-jump/keyboard support, tick marks, a floating value bubble, horizontal/vertical orientation, and ngModel/reactive forms support.

dialog.name: dialog
dialog.description: A modal dialog controlled by reference (show()/hide()/toggle()), always portaled to document.body, with focus trap, background scroll lock, and focus restoration on close. Includes a DialogService for opening any component in a dialog imperatively, PrimeNG DynamicDialog-style.

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.description: A panel that slides in from a viewport edge (left/right/top/bottom), controlled by reference (show()/hide()/toggle()) with the same focus trap/scroll lock/portal behavior as Dialog.

file-upload.name: file-upload
file-upload.description: A drag-and-drop / click-to-browse file picker with accept/maxFileSize/maxFiles validation, image thumbnail previews, and ngModel/reactive/Signal Forms support.

toast.name: toast
toast.description: A ToastService (injectable anywhere) plus a <z-toast-container> to mount once in your app root -- success()/error()/warning()/info() helpers, auto-dismiss with pause-on-hover, positioned corners.

carousel.name: carousel
carousel.description: A single-slide-at-a-time carousel with a required #slide template slot, autoplay (paused on hover), looping, arrow keys, and pointer-drag/swipe.

date-picker.name: date-picker
date-picker.description: A calendar date picker with an inline option (no popover, calendar always visible), min/max/custom date disabling, keyboard grid navigation, and ngModel/reactive/Signal Forms support.

color-picker.name: color-picker
color-picker.description: A hex color picker: saturation/value square, hue slider, typeable hex field, preset swatches, an inline option, and ngModel/reactive/Signal Forms support.

table.name: table
table.description: A data-driven table with optional per-column sorting, a global filter box (via <z-text-input>), single/multiple row selection (via <z-checkbox>), a rows-per-page dropdown (via <z-select>), a "Showing X to Y of Z" summary, #cell/#header/#footer/#loading templates, and built-in pagination via <z-pagination>.

chart.name: chart
chart.description: An SVG chart supporting line, bar, area, pie, and donut via a type input -- no canvas, no external charting library. Gridlines/axes and a clickable legend for cartesian types, hover tooltips for all types.
